thread:
anna_devex: Morning — quick pulse for the SDK/docs/sample-app release tomorrow 10:00 PT. Who's owning quickstarts, sample app smoke, and the final changelog merge? Any blockers? Need final PRs in by 02:00 PT. cc @release-engineering

josh_sdk: I'll own the SDK release + package publish. PR #842 is waiting on one review from @mike_docs. I'll be on call at 09:30 PT to cut. If everything's green I plan to push the package after canary.

mike_docs: On docs: nearly done. Waiting on the API snippet from @sandra_engine, then I can update the quickstarts and screenshots. I'll take changelog merge once docs PR lands. Docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/pull/129

sandra_engine: Sending the API snippet now — added a small note in PR 129. Also flag: sample app tests are failing in CI for Node 18 on mac (see ticket DEVEX-678). Investigating.

anna_devex: @sandra can you estimate ETA on that? We need changelog merged by 02:00 PT to make the window.

sandra_engine: ETA ~1.5h. The failing test looks flaky; I can either pin a dev dep or submit a small fix. I'll push a hotfix PR in ~40m.

josh_sdk: If the hotfix lands before 02:00 PT I can proceed. If not, plan B is to cut SDK without the sampleapp change (not ideal). Prefer to wait for the fix.

release-engineering: Reminder: release window at 10:00 PT tomorrow. Run a dry-run: `./scripts/release.sh --dry-run` and confirm artifacts.

maria_support: Quick question — have the quickstart tutorial screenshots been updated for the CLI changes? I spotted old output in the staging docs.

mike_docs: I updated screenshots in PR 130 (assets/screens/*). Needs final review from @anna_devex.

anna_devex: I'll review PR 130 in 20m. Quick checklist for go/no-go: (1) SDK PR green, (2) docs merged, (3) sample app smoke pass. Once those are met I'll merge the changelog.

josh_sdk: tagging @oncall for runtime monitoring during canary.

oncall: I'll monitor canary and have rollback ready. Threshold: if p95 latency > 500ms for first 100 requests or error rate > 1% we rollback.

sandra_engine: Hotfix PR 131 pushed — fixes Node 18 test. CI rerunning now.

mike_docs: CI passed for docs + screenshots. Merging now.

anna_devex: Changelog PR is ready to merge once SDK is green. @josh you good to publish at ~09:50 PT so we have a short bake before 10:00 PT?

josh_sdk: Yes — publishing at 09:50 PT. Will post the release URL and tag here when done.

maria_support: Thanks — I'll prepare the customer-facing note and update the help center entry once you share the tag.

josh_sdk: Done: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/releases/tag/v1.4.0 — canary started.

oncall: Canary looks healthy after first minute. median latency ~120ms, errors 0.2% — :thumbsup:. I'll keep watching for 15m.

sandra_engine: Sample app smoke passed locally and CI succeeded after the hotfix.

anna_devex: Final owners recap: SDK: josh_sdk; Docs & quickstarts: mike_docs; Sample apps: sandra_engine; Release ops: anna_devex. Closing loop — if anything pops up ping this thread. :party_parrot:
